blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative two times the quantity three x squared minus four x plus five.
Negative two multiplies every term inside the parentheses. Negative two times three x squared, negative two times negative four x, and negative two times five.
Negative two times three x squared is negative six x squared. Negative times negative is positive, so negative two times negative four x is eight x. And negative two times five is negative ten.
So the answer is negative six x squared plus eight x minus ten.

Watch out for these traps. If you make the middle term negative, you get negative six x squared minus eight x minus ten. If you forget to multiply the five, you get negative six x squared plus eight x plus five.
